rows.raw_answer: The paper reports that the hybrid tiled CNN (HTCNN) performs better than both CNN and tiled CNN on the IMDB movie reviews and SemEval 2017 datasets [1]. On SemEval, the results confirm the performance of HTCNN over simple CNN [3]. The conclusions state that, if the tile size is chosen properly, the model could achieve competitive performance with the TCNN and better results than the reference CNN model [3]. The paper also notes that the HTCNN achieves the best performance without the drawbacks of the other two models: the inflexible filter structure of the TCNN and the SHTCNN's lack of n-grams [5]. However, the evidence does not provide specific quantitative margins of improvement over the counterparts.
